# Getting Support

Having trouble with an Involvex project? Here's how to get help:

## Start Here

1. **Read the documentation** — Check the [official docs](https://involvex.github.io/involvex/) and the repository's `README.md` for common setup questions.

2. **Search GitHub** — Browse [existing discussions](https://github.com/involvex/discussions) and [issues](https://github.com/involvex) — your question may have already been asked.

3. **Ask the community** — Start a [discussion](https://github.com/involvex/discussions) or reach out on social media.

## Support Channels

| Type                | Where                                                         |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 🐛 Bug reports       | [File a bug report](https://github.com/involvex/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| ✨ Feature requests  | [File a feature request](https://github.com/involvex/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| ❓ Questions & help   | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/involvex/discussions) |
| 🔐 Security issues   | Email `involvex@proton.me` (see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)) |
| 📢 General community | [GitHub](https://github.com/involvex) · [X/Twitter](https://x.com/Involvexdev) · [Reddit](https://reddit.com/u/involvex) |

## What We Support

We provide best-effort support for:

- Installation and configuration issues
- Bugs in released versions
- Feature usage questions

We do **not** provide support for:

- Custom implementations beyond the documented API
- Issues with your own tooling or environment
- Troubleshooting in private — please open a public discussion instead

## Filing an Issue

If you've confirmed this is a bug or feature request after checking the docs and existing issues, please use the appropriate issue template:

- Use **Bug Report** for crashes, errors, or unexpected behavior.
- Use **Feature Request** for new functionality suggestions.

Issues that are questions, support requests, or do not follow the template may be closed or redirected to Discussions.

---

We're excited to help — just reach out!
